findings.title: Liability Mismatch Between Upstream Infrastructure and Downstream Customer SLA
findings.claim: Meridian Labs owes Northstar Retail INR 100,000 for qualifying outages, but can only recover a maximum of INR 30,000 in non-cash service credits from Atlas Cloud, creating an unrecoverable net loss of INR 70,000 per incident.
findings.attack_path: An unplanned outage occurs on Atlas Cloud. Northstar demands an INR 100,000 credit under northstar-6.1. Meridian Labs seeks recovery from Atlas Cloud under atlas-8.3, but receives only INR 30,000 as a future invoice credit. Northstar's SLA explicitly prevents offsetting this with provider recovery under northstar-9.1, forcing Meridian Labs to absorb the INR 70,000 gap.

evidence.quote: An unplanned production outage lasting more than 60 consecutive minutes requires Meridian Labs to issue an INR 100,000 service credit to Northstar Retail within 30 calendar days of the incident date.
Customer service credits are independent of any recovery Meridian Labs may obtain from its infrastructure providers.
Service credits are the sole monetary remedy and are capped at INR 30,000 per incident. Credits are applied to future invoices, not paid in cash.

assumptions: The outage on 2026-10-25 was caused by Atlas Cloud infrastructure and lasted 95 minutes, qualifying under both agreements.

findings.title: Imminent Automatic Renewal of Prism Analytics License
findings.claim: Meridian Labs will incur an automatic renewal liability of INR 240,000 on 1 December 2026 unless cancellation notice is given by 1 November 2026.
findings.attack_path: Meridian Labs fails to submit a written cancellation notice by 1 November 2026 at 23:59 UTC. The agreement automatically renews on 1 December 2026, creating a binding fee obligation of INR 240,000 for the following annual term with no refund available.

evidence.quote: This license renews automatically on 1 December 2026 for another annual term at INR 240,000 unless written cancellation is received by 1 November 2026 at 23:59 UTC.
Cancellation prevents future renewal only; it does not refund fees paid for the current term.

assumptions: The current date is 2026-10-25, leaving 7 calendar days to execute a non-renewal notice if desired.

rulings.rationale: Clause northstar-6.1 obligates Meridian Labs to issue an INR 100,000 credit for qualifying unplanned outages, while atlas-8.3 caps Atlas Cloud recovery at INR 30,000 in future non-cash credits. Clause prism-5.1 establishes that the Prism Analytics License automatically renews on 1 December 2026 for INR 240,000 unless written cancellation is received by 1 November 2026 at 23:59 UTC. As of 25 October 2026, 7 days remain before the non-renewal deadline.

actions.title: Submit Atlas Cloud Service Credit Claim
actions.draft:
Subject: Service Credit Claim - Unplanned Production Infrastructure Outage (2026-10-25)

To Atlas Cloud Support / Accounts Team,

Meridian Labs hereby submits a formal claim for a service credit under Clause 8.2 of the Atlas Cloud Services Agreement following a qualifying unplanned production outage on 25 October 2026 lasting 95 consecutive minutes. 

Per Clause 4.2 and Clause 8.2, Meridian Labs is eligible for an INR 30,000 service credit. Attached is the incident report provided by our operational support partner in accordance with Clause 8.2. Please confirm receipt of this claim and approve the application of the INR 30,000 credit against our future invoices per Clause 8.3.

Required Attachments: Incident Support Report (Beacon Operations)

Sincerely,
Authorized Signatory
Meridian Labs

actions.draft:
Subject: Notice of Non-Renewal - Prism Analytics License

To Prism Software Account Management,

Meridian Labs hereby provides formal written notice of cancellation and non-renewal for the Prism Analytics License (term 1 December 2025 to 30 November 2026), pursuant to Clause 5.1 of the Prism Analytics License agreement.

This notice is delivered prior to the 1 November 2026 23:59 UTC deadline to ensure the agreement does not automatically renew for the subsequent term commencing 1 December 2026. Please confirm receipt of this non-renewal notice and acknowledge that no further fees of INR 240,000 will be billed for the 2026–2027 annual term per Clause 5.1 and Clause 5.2.

Sincerely,
Authorized Signatory
Meridian Labs
